heading: SECTION 0
description: The Government of India felt the need for a permanent agency to expedite the publication of standards and development of test facilities in parallel when the work on the preparation of the standards is going on, as the development of improved safety critical parts can be undertaken only after the publication of the standard and commissioning of test facilities. To this end, the erstwhile Ministry of Surface Transport (MOST) has constituted a permanent Automotive Industry Standards Committee (AISC) vide order No. RT-11028/11/97-MVL dated September 15, 1997. The standards prepared by AISC will be approved by the permanent CMVR Technical Standing Committee (CTSC). After approval, the Automotive Research Association of India, (ARAI), Pune, being the Secretariat of the AIS Committee, has published this standard. For better dissemination of this information ARAI may publish this document on their Web site.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Gas-discharge light source": light source in which the light is produced by a stabilized discharge arc.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Ballast": Specific electrical supply for the gas-discharge light source, optionally integrated with the light source.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Rated voltage": Input voltage marked on the ballast or on the light source in the case that the ballast is integrated with the light source.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Rated wattage": Wattage marked on the gas-discharge light source and ballast.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Test voltage": Voltage, at the input terminals of the ballast or at the terminals of the light source in the case that the ballast is integrated with the light source, for which the electrical and photometric characteristics of the gas-discharge light source are intended and are to be tested.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Objective value": Design value of an electrical or photometric characteristic. To be achieved, within the specified tolerances, when the gas-discharge light source is energized by the ballast, optionally integrated with the light source, and operated at test voltage.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Standard (etalon) gas-discharge light source": Special gas-discharge light source used for the testing of headlamps. It has reduced dimensional, electrical and photometric characteristics as specified on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Reference axis": An axis defined with reference to the cap and to which certain dimensions of the gas-discharge light source are referred.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Definitions
description: "Reference plane": a plane defined with reference to the cap and to which certain dimensions of the gas-discharge light source are referred.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: General specifications
description: Each sample submitted shall conform to the relevant specifications of this standard when tested, in the case the ballast is not integrated with the light source with the ballast according to clause 2.2.2.4. above.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: General specifications
description: Gas-discharge light sources shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use. They shall moreover exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The discharge arc shall be the only element of the gas-discharge light source that generates and emits light when energized
description: The discharge arc shall be the only element of the gas-discharge light source that generates and emits light when energized.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The bulb of the gas-discharge light source shall exhibit no scores or spots which might impair their efficiency and their optical performance
description: The bulb of the gas-discharge light source shall exhibit no scores or spots which might impair their efficiency and their optical performance.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Manufacture
description: In the case of a coloured (outer) bulb, after an operating period of 15 hours with the ballast or the light source with the ballast integrated at test voltage, the surface of the bulb shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture of 70 volume per cent of n-heptane and 30 volume per cent of toluol. After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It shall not show any apparent changes

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Manufacture
description: Gas-discharge light sources shall be equipped with standard caps complying with the cap data sheets of IEC Publication 60061, as specified on the individual data sheets of Annex A.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The cap shall be strong and firmly secured to the bulb
description: The cap shall be strong and firmly secured to the bulb.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Manufacture
description: To ascertain whether gas-discharge light sources conform to the requirements of clause 3.3.3. to clause 3.3.4., above, a visual inspection, a dimension check and, where appropriate, a trial fitting shall be carried out.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Gas-discharge light sources shall be aged as indicated in Annex D
description: Gas-discharge light sources shall be aged as indicated in Annex D.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: All samples shall be tested with the ballast, according to clause 2.2.2.4 above, in case the ballast is not integrated with the light source
description: All samples shall be tested with the ballast, according to clause 2.2.2.4 above, in case the ballast is not integrated with the light source.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Electrical measurements shall be carried out with instruments of at least class 0.2 (0.2 percent full scale accuracy)
description: Electrical measurements shall be carried out with instruments of at least class 0.2 (0.2 percent full scale accuracy).

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Position and dimensions of electrodes, arc and stripes
description: The geometric position of the electrodes shall be as specified on the relevant data sheet. An example of a method of measuring arc and electrodes position is given in Annex E. Other methods may be used.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Position and dimensions of electrodes, arc and stripes
description: The position and dimensions of the light source electrodes shall be measured before the ageing period, the gas-discharge light source unlit and using optical methods through the glass envelope.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The shape and the displacement of the arc shall conform to the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet
description: The shape and the displacement of the arc shall conform to the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The measurement shall be made after ageing with the light source supplied by the ballast at test voltage or the light source with the ballast integrated at test voltage
description: The measurement shall be made after ageing with the light source supplied by the ballast at test voltage or the light source with the ballast integrated at test voltage.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The position and dimension and transmission of the stripes shall comply with the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet
description: The position and dimension and transmission of the stripes shall comply with the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: The measurement shall be made after ageing with the light source supplied by the ballast at test voltage or the light source with the ballast integrated at test voltage
description: The measurement shall be made after ageing with the light source supplied by the ballast at test voltage or the light source with the ballast integrated at test voltage.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Starting
description: When tested according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the gasdischarge light source shall start directly and remain alight.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: For gas-discharge light sources having an objective luminous flux which exceeds 2,000 lm
description: For gas-discharge light sources having an objective luminous flux which exceeds 2,000 lm: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex D to this standard, the gas-discharge light source shall emit at least: After 1 second: 25 per cent of its objective luminous flux; After 4 seconds: 80 per cent of its objective luminous flux. The objective luminous flux as indicated on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: For gas-discharge light sources having an objective luminous flux which does not exceed 2000 lm and does not contain black stripes
description: For gas-discharge light sources having an objective luminous flux which does not exceed 2000 lm and does not contain black stripes: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the gasdischarge light sources shall emit at least 800 lm after 1 second and at least 1,000 lm after 4 seconds. The objective luminous flux as indicated on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: For gas-discharge light sources having an objective luminous flux which does not exceed 2,000 lm but does contain black stripes
description: For gas-discharge light sources having an objective luminous flux which does not exceed 2,000 lm but does contain black stripes: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the gasdischarge light sources shall emit at least 700 lm after 1 second and at least 900 lm after 4 seconds. The objective luminous flux as indicated on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: For gas-discharge light sources having more than one objective luminous flux, and at least one objective luminous flux does not exceed 2,000 lm
description: For gas-discharge light sources having more than one objective luminous flux, and at least one objective luminous flux does not exceed 2,000 lm: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the gasdischarge light sources shall emit at least 800 lm after 1 second and at least 1,000 lm after 4 seconds. The objective luminous flux as indicated on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Hot-restrike
description: When tested according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the gas-discharge light source shall restart directly after being switched-off for a period as indicated on the data sheet. After one second the light source shall emit at least 80 per cent of its objective luminous flux.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Electrical characteristics
description: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the voltage and wattage of the light source shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Luminous flux
description: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex D, the luminous flux shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet. In the case where white and selective yellow is specified for the same type, the objective value applies to light sources emitting white light, whereas the luminous flux of the light source emitting selective yellow light shall be at least 68 per cent of the specified value.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Colour
description: The colour of the light emitted shall be white or selective yellow. Moreover the colorimetric characteristics, expressed in CIE chromaticity coordinates, shall lie within the boundaries given on the relevant data sheet.

heading: See Annex D
subheading: Colour
description: The definitions of the colour of the light emitted, given in AIS008 Rev. 3 and its amendments in force at the time of application for type approval shall apply to this standard.

heading: See Annex D

Note : Such changes will be considered for inclusion in this standard at the time of its next revision.
